sources.citation: Tastevin, Constant. 1936. Vocabulaires inédits de sept dialectes sénégalais dont six de la Casamance. Journal de la Société des Africanistes 6(1): 1-33.
sources.note: Persée page read via web lookups: includes a Bayot wordlist from Nyassia; no remark on accent in the introductory notes.

sources.citation: Diagne, Mbacké. n.d. Noun quantification in Bayot-Kugere. Manuscript (Sénélangues project site, MS Word).
sources.note: Raw-text scan of the.doc (LibreOffice could not load it; olefile/strings extraction) finds no accent/stress/tone mention; noun quantifiers only.

sources.citation: Dabo, Mamadou. 2024. La négation en joola édammé (langue atlantique du nord-ouest de la Guinée-Bissau). Éditions Francophones Universitaires d'Afrique, Jan. 2024, pp. 75-88.
sources.note: Silent (negation morphology). Describes édammé (Guinea-Bissau Bayot = Glottolog Arame-Gubaare), not bayo1255.

sources.citation: Thornell, Christina. 2020. Milieu langagier chez les Bayotte au Sénégal, aujourd'hui et dans l'avenir. SIL Electronic Survey Reports 2020-006. Dallas: SIL International. 78 pp.
sources.note: Sociolinguistic survey; silent on stress ('accent' occurs only meaning emphasis). Section 5.4.4.2 (p. 51-52) and Appendice G (p. 71-72) inventory the Bayot linguistic literature (Diagne 1999, 2009a/b, 2011a-d, 2012a, 2014; Nyafouna 2005; Dabo 2013). fetched sources via Wayback 2024-11-16 capture; sil.org Cloudflare blocks direct download.

sources.citation: Diagne, Mbacké. 2015. Classes nominales en bayot kugere. In Creissels, D. & K. Pozdniakov (eds), Les classes nominales dans les langues atlantiques, 147-169. Köln: Köppe. (Sénélangues pre-print, 24 pp.)
sources.note: Section 2 'Préalables phonologiques et morphophonologiques' treats only the vowel system (25 vowels from 5 bases x ±ATR, ±long, ±nasal), ATR harmony, assimilation and vowel elision; no mention of stress, accent or tone anywhere in the chapter.

sources.citation: Diagne, Mbacké. 2014. La réciprocité en bayot-kugere. SudLangues 21.
sources.note: Silent; the only 'accent' is the orthographic acute accent marking +ATR vowels (í ú é ó á) per the Senegalese codification decree (p. 2 of the PDF). Wayback 2023-01-31 capture.

sources.citation: Diagne, Mbacké. 2012. Fonctions dérivatives des marqueurs de classe nominale en bayot-kugere. SudLangues 17: 91-113.
Diagne, Mbacké. 2011. La question de la voix en bayot-kugere: voix passive et voix moyenne. SudLangues 15: 121-138.
sources.note: Silent (morphosyntax of voice; footnote 1 gives typological sketch: noun classes, TAM, SVO). fetched sources from Wayback 2023-01-29 capture; sudlangues.sn domain no longer resolves.

sources.citation: Sénélangues project (ANR-09-BLAN-0326, LLACAN/DDL). Language sheet 'BAYOT — M. Diagne' (1 p.) and bibliography sheet 'G2. Bayot' (1 p.).
sources.note: Nothing on stress; names kugere, kuhiŋe; Nyassia; 12,000 speakers; bibliography = Barry 1987, Carlton & Rand 1993/1994, Diagne 2009a/b, Kennedy 1964, Tastevin 1936.
